SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — authored for this project's tests

# Aurelian Basin indicator summary (invented data)

All indicator values below are invented for parser and chunker tests. They
follow no real dataset; the table exists so table-extraction behaviour has a
fixture to run against.

## Headline indicators, 2024 reporting year

| Indicator | Baseline (1861–1880) | 2024 value | Change | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basin-mean temperature | 11.2 °C | 13.1 °C | +1.9 °C | very likely anthropogenic |
| Southern-terrace rainfall | 640 mm/yr | 550 mm/yr | −14 % | high confidence |
| Verlan aquifer level | 0 m (datum) | −8.3 m | −8.3 m | high confidence |
| Copperwood extent | 41,000 km² | 36,900 km² | −10 % | medium confidence |
| Shelf-water CO₂ uptake | 12 Mt/yr | 9 Mt/yr | −25 % | low confidence |

## Notes on the table

The change column is computed from the two invented value columns and has no
external source. A second, narrower table follows to exercise multi-table
handling:

| Scenario | Basin warming at 2050 |
|---|---|
| Low pathway | +0.4 °C |
| Middle pathway | +0.9 °C |
| High pathway | +1.6 °C |
